subject: RVL-120
notes: This package ships no art, no sound and no texture. The specification counts one interface texture in the shipped resources and four more belonging to a demonstration source set that is not part of the shipped artifact; none was opened or read, none is tracked, and nothing was rewritten from reference. The single block-state document the original ships is deliberately not carried, because it names a model for a block that is not registered at the reviewed revision. `census::TEXTURE` names the one path a dependent would look for and no bytes sit behind it.
